season.evidence: Web: guides give about July to October, late summer to early fall best; snow in the gully and boulder field in early July, a snow-free mid-October ledge. Stored Jun-Sep; Oct tolerated.

track.why: Only route stored on the peak; 21 Sep 2026 round trip from Barclay Lake trailhead (start 1 m, end 6 m) follows the Barclay Creek climbers path to the summit (17 m from our pin); report describes the same class 3 exposed scramble.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 19 Sep 2026 also complete; 3355232 chosen as the more recent with a report.
Oct 3 oneway, 292 m start; valid but not best.

facts.text: In early October the creek is crossed on logs, one of which was rotting at its far end.
Around 3,800 ft the path forks; the right-hand branch climbs a very steep gully that is treacherous when wet, while the main path avoids it.
The second gully crossing near 4,000 ft is easy on the lower line; if it feels hard, the rest will be too.
Near 5,800 ft expect sustained class 3 with a couple of class 4 moves, then a narrow exposed ledge around the north side.
In mid-July there are good water sources near the top of the first steep climb and patches of snow can remain.

notes: Single stored route; track follows the Barclay Creek climbers path. No pin changes.
